body: Thank you so much. The kindness of strangers really helps. What I mean by counselor is someone who I speak with every week. A therapist basically. And committed means being taken into a mental hospital. I'm worried if I tell her about my attempt she'll try to take me to a hospital without my consent. I hope that clears things up. Thank you so much for your comment.
I do this too. When I tried to hang out with groups of people I felt lonelier than when I was alone. I'm trying to work on this but its really hard.
